change: Convert async reset (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) to sync reset (posedge clk) in all cache FSM always_ff blocks
motivation: ASAP7 run 11 identified DFFASRHQNx1 as bottleneck FF; async reset load and QN output add ~60-120 ps to critical path; sync reset maps to DFFHQx1 which is faster
lint_result: PASS: 0 errors, 0 warnings (Verilator --lint-only --no-timing with sram_1rw_256x32_verilator.v stub, full rv32i_cpu_top hierarchy)

issues_encountered: sram_1rw_256x32_freepdk45 macro not found by Verilator — PDK black-box not in RTL tree
fixes_applied: Created rtl/mem/sram_1rw_256x32_freepdk45.sv behavioural stub for lint purposes

Converted 11 always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) blocks to @(posedge clk) across 6 files: rv32i_pipeline_if.sv (3 blocks), rv32i_pipeline_id.sv (1), rv32i_pipeline_ex.sv (2), rv32i_pipeline_mem.sv (1), rv32i_core.sv (2), rv32i_csr_file.sv (1), rv32i_regfile.sv (1)
notes: Async-to-sync reset conversion for ASAP7 DFFHQNx1 target. rv32i_pipeline_wb.sv, rv32i_hazard_unit.sv, rv32i_interrupt_ctrl.sv have no async-reset FFs — purely combinational or no rst_n. Zero %Error and zero %Warning-SYNCASYNCNET after conversion. Verilator lint must use absolute paths from nix-shell in librelane dir.

fixes_applied: Converted 5 remaining async-reset blocks in rv32i_cpu_top.sv (APB debug registers: last_commit_insn_q, dbg_halted_prev, halt_latch_q+step_pending_q, APB write logic, halt_cause_lat)
notes: All synthesised RTL now fully sync-reset. grep 'negedge rst_n' returns zero hits in all files included in ASAP7 config.json VERILOG_FILES. Correct lint command: cd ~/Downloads/Github/librelane && nix-shell --run 'make -C /home/neuromorphic/Downloads/Github/claude_verilog_test/sim lint' — uses sim/Makefile VERILOG_SOURCES (includes correct SRAM stub). Lint passes with only BLKSEQ warnings on valid_array/dirty_array flush loops (intentional blocking assignments for procedural invalidation loops — functionally correct).

alu_result used for both JALR redirect target and D-cache address — both consumers must remain correct after retiming
store byte-align logic (pre_wdata_aligned/pre_wstrb) depends on alu_result[1:0] in EX — already pre-computed before EX/MEM register
branch compare (rv32i_branch_comp) is parallel to ALU — not in the critical path through alu_result
forwarding unit EX→EX path consumes ex_mem_reg.alu_result combinationally — must add EX2→EX forwarding if ALU moves to EX2
load-use stall currently 1 cycle for load-in-EX; adding EX2 stage makes load-result available 1 cycle later, potentially requiring 2-cycle stall
notes: Planning session only — no RTL modified. Full retiming plan produced as assistant output. EX2 approach chosen over operand-pre-register approach due to lower forwarding complexity. See plan in conversation.

stall_ex_mem port removed from EX module since EX2 owns the register

issues_encountered: hit signal (combinational) in CS_TAG_CHECK had 821 synthesis fanout loads causing -800ps WNS on ASAP7
task spec used wrong port names (clk_i/rst_n_i); actual ports are clk/rst_n
fixes_applied: Added CS_HIT_PENDING state (3'b110) to cache_state_t enum in rv32i_cache_pkg.sv
Replaced combinational hit signal with hit_comb (pure tag compare, no state guard) + registered hit_q + 4 per-bank registered hit_bank_q copies in rv32i_dcache.sv
CS_SRAM_LATCH now transitions to CS_HIT_PENDING instead of CS_TAG_CHECK
CS_HIT_PENDING unconditionally advances to CS_TAG_CHECK (registers hit_comb this cycle)
dc_stall_o adds CS_HIT_PENDING stall cycle; CS_TAG_CHECK uses !hit_q
Data SRAM write control uses hit_bank_q[latch_word] instead of hit
FSM CS_TAG_CHECK hit branch and dirty array update use hit_q
Hazard unit: no change needed (purely stall-propagation, no hard-coded latency)
MEM stage: no change needed (uses dc_stall_i as level signal only)
cache_model.py: no change needed (transaction-level only, no FSM cycle tracking)
notes: Hit path now adds 1 extra stall cycle for cache hits (CS_IDLE->CS_SRAM_LATCH->CS_HIT_PENDING->CS_TAG_CHECK->CS_IDLE = 4 stall cycles for hit vs 3 before). Miss/refill/writeback paths unchanged. The (* keep=1 *) attribute on hit_bank_q prevents synthesis from merging the 4 copies back into one net. Lint: 0 errors, 5 pre-existing warnings (BLKSEQ in reset loops, UNUSEDPARAM REFILL_BEATS, DECLFILENAME on SRAM stub) — all pre-existing, none introduced by this change.
